_comment: Authored two-handed swings for tools/creature_fit.py author (2026-09-30). The body (legs, pelvis, spine, neck, head) and the timing come from a Fab troll attack; the hammer's path is keyed here and both arms are solved onto it. fist = the main grip: x right and y forward from the midpoint of the two shoulder joints, in the body's yaw frame (from the pelvis), z = height above the ground in metres. dir = the shaft, fist toward the hammer head, in the same frame. The striking face turns each frame to lead the hammer head's own motion (vanilla swings lead with -X), so at a downward impact the 1.2 m head block stands on end: its centre must sit ~0.6 m up for the face to meet the ground. Design rules from the troll's geometry: the skull (radius ~0.45 m) sits ~0.4 m in front of the shoulder line in the stance, so arms raised straight up pass behind it; head_hold keeps the stance's neck and head through the raise (the Fab raise throws the head back into the off arm's path).

keys._: stance: hammer up over the right side
coming over: head high in front
impact: the face meets the ground ~4 m out
